criteria.text: A live profile icon asset path is never rendered as inline avatar text and the profile row remains readable.
criteria.reason: Rendered profile flow asserts initials, no image, and no raw asset path.

criteria.text: An unservable or broken profile icon asset path falls back to a derived short label instead of a broken image.
criteria.reason: Rendered profile flow proves the unservable app asset path uses the derived AP fallback.

criteria.text: Editing and saving a real profile does not silently truncate or corrupt its stored asset-path icon.
criteria.reason: Rendered live PATCH capture preserves assets/agents/release-steward/avatar.png after an unrelated prompt edit.

criteria.text: Manually editing the advanced cwd clears the previously selected project's stale branch so the create request does not send that branch.
criteria.reason: Rendered advanced-session flow selects feature/rendered, changes cwd, asserts the current-cwd option, and captures a POST with no branch property.
